scope: Broaden the existing DWG/DXF 3D evidence ladder to distinguish ACIS carrier/shape evidence from downstream modeling-operation compatibility, while rechecking the FreeCAD converter route.

evidenceKinds: open-source project discussion and maintainer response
downstream application format documentation and issue response
notPerformed: FreeCAD native runtime on Linux, Windows, or macOS

evidence.route: ezdxf-generated AC1032 solid and downstream Boolean operation
observed: The reporter describes an ezdxf 1.4.0-created AC1032 3DSOLID for which AutoCAD MASSPROP worked and DXF AUDIT reported no errors, while a Dynamo Boolean intersection did not behave like the same operation on solids created within AutoCAD.
The report provides no drawing, file hash, independent reproduction, minimized case, or exact resulting geometry; the proposed missing-metadata explanation is speculation.
The ezdxf maintainer described its ACIS support as basic; this limits the peer's general writer claims but does not identify the cause of the reported Boolean behavior.
limits: This is an unverified user workflow report, not evidence of a libdxfrw defect or a reproduced ezdxf defect.
A clean audit, successful import, or mass-property result does not by itself establish downstream operation compatibility.
One Boolean operation cannot establish all Boolean behavior or general B-rep validity.
evidence.planAction: At the already-composed consumer checkpoint, optionally record one named Boolean operation only when evaluating an editable/modeler-solid claim. Use locally generated asymmetric overlapping bodies with independent expected metrics and exact source-to-body identity. Keep this observation separate from carrier retention, parser acceptance, topology validity, metrics, and native CAD open. Do not create a new implementation finding or make it mandatory for carrier/read/2D claims.

evidence.route: cross-project writer, carrier, and operation reports
observed: OpenCADStudio issue #1615 remained open at review time; its reporter describes AutoCAD/ProgeCAD and Boolean problems, while the maintainer reports one current-main SUBTRACT result opening in an unnamed strict third-party reader.
ACadSharp issue #1195 describes silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission in version 3.4.9; its linked ACIS DXF-writer PR #1240 remained open and dependent on ACDS/ACIS schema work at review time.
LibreDWG issue #1411 reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss in a specified LibreDWG 0.14.8593 build; it is a version-scoped issue report, not a current-master runtime result.
These reports concern distinct lineages and failure classes: Boolean operation behavior, writer omission, and modern DWG carrier extraction.
limits: Issue and pull-request reports are not reproducible cross-peer test results and do not establish a shared defect.
An unnamed strict reader, an open PR, or a report of application-level Boolean behavior cannot serve as a support pass.
No customer drawing or peer runtime was retrieved or executed.
evidence.planAction: Keep operation behavior, writer completeness, and AcDs carrier preservation as distinct columns. Reuse existing source-to-output inventory and exact-release gates; do not duplicate implementation work or infer libdxfrw defects from peer reports.

observed: The current importDWG.py ODA branch requests ACAD2000 DXF, waits for the process, then accepts the expected output path without checking the child return code.
FreeCAD documentation describes stock DXF/DWG geometry support as 2D because the ACIS modeler representation is not interpreted by that route.
The FreeCAD maintainer's issue response distinguishes explicit DXF entities from proprietary ACIS blobs and says stock FreeCAD cannot read the latter.
limits: The source path is mutable main and was not executed; the exact installed app, converter, preferences, and platform remain unqualified.
The ODA ACAD2000 route is not representative of all configured converter choices and cannot test preservation of modern R2013+ SAB/ACDSDATA by itself.
evidence.planAction: Cross-check only: the existing plan already requires converter identity/argv/return code, fresh output, actual DXF version/hash, importer backend, and final document inventory. Preserve a distinct ODA_ACAD2000_DXF profile and keep stock FreeCAD outside ACIS semantic qualification; do not add a duplicate task.

implementationReadiness.consumerCheckpoint: Optional composed-stage observation only; no per-slice peer runtime.
implementationReadiness.operationProbeAdmission: Use only for a claim about editable/modeler-solid behavior; if unavailable record NOT_AVAILABLE or NOT_RUN without downgrading carrier/read/2D claims.
implementationReadiness.inputPolicy: Generate local asymmetric analytic bodies in a temporary location; add no external drawing fixture.
implementationReadiness.expectedResultPolicy: Bind source handles and owner/block paths to output bodies and compare against independently authored operation-specific bounds/volume/validity expectations.
